reference.comparison: force vectors and deterministic KDK state

grid.domain: source AABB expanded by one length unit on every side; degenerate axes use a two-unit span centered on the source coordinate
grid.boundary: finite non-periodic; coordinates outside the domain are clamped to the nearest cell
grid.field: softened discrete Newton Green convolution at cell centers
grid.interpolation: trilinear field interpolation with the same clamped cell policy
grid.ordering: z-major flat cells, then ascending source index

treepm.composition: 0.5 PM long-range field plus 0.5 Barnes-Hut field

distributed.reason: P5 does not define a global mesh ownership or halo contract
distributed.preflight: reject before transaction, migration, or state mutation

lifecycle.initialization: allocate bounded grid storage in the solver constructor
lifecycle.preparation: derive the finite domain, clear storage, deposit sources, and build the field
lifecycle.failure: validate all views and commit force output only after a complete field evaluation

acceptance.state_repeatability: byte equal for identical inputs and settings
acceptance.mass_conservation: deposited grid mass equals source mass within 1e-12 relative
acceptance.reference_policy: Direct CPU remains unchanged and is the numerical oracle
acceptance.sanitizers: ASan and UBSan on the same CPU test matrix when toolchains are available

artifacts.timing_claim: none; P5 qualification records correctness and allocation behavior only
